name: A. Resonant overview
description: A tour of one real project: the scene, the 3D viewport, a calculated field, and where mechanics and electromagnetics live.
expected: a focal spot on the field plane at the target, about 6 cm in front of the array
a saved copy of the project in the run folder

story.problem: Engineers who shape waves need one place to build a design, calculate what it does and see it.
story.configure: Nothing: the demonstration opens a saved project with a focused planar array, a target and a field plane.
story.calculate: The free-field pressure of the 64 elements on the field plane (analytical superposition of point sources).
story.meaning: The bright spot is where the elements' waves arrive in phase: the focus the array was set up for.
story.inspect: The scene tree lists the objects; the property editor shows the selected array; the viewport shows the field in 3D.
story.value: Design, simulation and results stay in one project file, for acoustics, mechanics and electromagnetics alike.
story.assumptions: Free field (no walls), linear acoustics, ideal point-source elements at 40 kHz in air.
